correctness.rationale: Subtract the realized finite-population mean: the error is (M/N) times the difference between the correction-sample and complement residual means, M=N−a. For every fixed population and nonsingular pilot, its finite randomization mean is zero and the design variance factor is M(M−b)/(N²b). This is a conditional design statement, not a claim of joint integrability at a=p. Conditional on the pilot and a particular correction set, the remaining Gaussian residuals have variance σ²+||δ||² for δ=β̂−β; the squared sum of their signed coefficients is γ for each set. With a rotational Gaussian design, the reciprocal of any unit-direction quadratic form of the inverse Gram matrix is χ²_(a−p+1) by residualizing one design column on the others. Cramér–Wold gives the full vector law σW/√U, and the correction's standardized Gaussian is independent of the pilot. Thus ||δ||²/σ²=V/U in law, and U/(U+V) is beta with shapes ν/2,p/2. Its inverse q/2 moment exists exactly for q<ν, with logarithmic divergence at equality, yielding the displayed gamma ratio and infinite MSE at a=p,p+1. Applying the same realized-target correction to the plain sample gives its reported risk and the strict ratio test at finite risk. In t=a−1 the derivative numerator is (L−c−p)t²+2pct−pcL, strictly increasing between its opposite endpoint signs; the rationalized root is the unique continuous minimum and monotonicity gives the two clipped integer neighbors. The singleton feasible split at B=p+3 is included. For fixed p and N/B→∞ with B→∞, t*/√(pB)→1; the factorization C_N=[(1−a/N)/(1−a/B)]/[1−p/(a−1)] then gives C_N−1~2√(p/B) at either minimizing rounded neighbor. Separately, at fixed p,B the N→∞ relaxation gives the stated exact lower envelope.

value.rationale: Design unbiasedness alone conceals infinite joint MSE at two feasible pilot sizes. The exact law and optimized signal threshold quantify when spending gradient evaluations on a pilot helps at a fixed evaluation budget versus plain sampling, with an explicit integer allocation rather than a heuristic. The practically interpretable control is for the stylized Gaussian experiment, not a claim about wall-clock time, regularization or SGD convergence.
residual_risks: Application value is a fixed-iterate benchmark, contingent on modeled covariates being cheaply available.
